title: Uninstall a Python package
summary: Remove a previously installed Python package from your system.

steps.explain: Remove the specified package. If you installed it with --user, you might need to run this without sudo.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the Python package to uninstall

rollback.explain: Reinstall the package if you removed it by mistake.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the Python package to reinstall

warnings: Uninstalling system-wide packages may require sudo.
